scope: Database snapshot management, evidence and home-page copy
data: Synthetic retained snapshots and isolated application storage
storage: Measured snapshot bytes include the manifest, row data and index
A new open reference after preview, a recoverable task, a saved recipe and an exported reconciliation result block removal
An unreadable reference catalogue or an unexpected sibling file prevents deletion
Operator confirmation removes an unreferenced snapshot
Killing the helper process releases the stage lease; active and unmarked staging directories are preserved
Encrypted restore reopens the original values and installs read-only snapshot files
The grid, explicit verification, open and evidence export reject same-length changes with restored modification time

interface.method: Isolated headless Chromium with the application service
checks: Three home menu entries and keyboard activation
Grid cell copy followed by mouse-drag selection and native Ctrl+C of home menu text
Independent and combined source, table, date and size filters, plus a capacity reminder
Table selection shows SQL, field definitions and part digests
Downloaded JSON bytes hash to the manifest SHA-256
Narrow evidence layout and cancelled or confirmed deletion

limits.referenceCoverage: Application-managed source bindings and identifiable local output records
